name: Giana Sisters Zero
author: OpenGGS Team / CardputerZero Community
description: The Great Giana Sisters C64 remake natively ported and adapted for M5Stack Cardputer ZERO ST7789 320x170 display and 46-key mechanical tactile matrix keyboard.

changelog.notes: Initial Cardputer ZERO release with native 320x170 logical resolution, compact 1-line HUD, 46-key matrix bindings, multi-slot save states, ES8389 audio optimization, battery monitoring, and APPLaunch integration.
